# Session Handoff Template

**Purpose:** Use this template at the end of each work session to document progress for the next session's agent.

---

## Session Information

**Session Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Session Number:** #N
**Agent/Tool Used:** [agent-name or "manual"]
**Task/Feature:** [Brief description]
**Overall Progress:** X% complete (N/M items)

---

## Completed This Session

### Files Modified
- ✅ `path/to/file1.py` - [What changed]
- ✅ `path/to/file2.py` - [What changed]

### Features Implemented
- ✅ [Feature/change description]
- ✅ [Feature/change description]

### Documentation Created
- ✅ `docs/some-doc.md` - [Purpose]

---

## In Progress (Partial Completion)

### Files Partially Modified
- ⚠️ `path/to/file3.py` - [What's done, what remains]
  - ✅ Done: [Specific changes completed]
  - ❌ Pending: [Specific changes needed]

### Features Partially Implemented
- ⚠️ [Feature description]
  - Status: [X% complete or specific milestone]
  - Next step: [What needs to happen next]

---

## Pending Work (Not Started)

### Next Priority Items
1. ❌ [Task description]
2. ❌ [Task description]
3. ❌ [Task description]

### Future Work (Lower Priority)
- ❌ [Task description]
- ❌ [Task description]

## Testing Status

### Completed Tests
- ✅ [Test description] - Result: PASS/FAIL
- ✅ [Test description] - Result: PASS/FAIL

### Pending Tests
- ❌ [Test to run]
- ❌ [Test to run]

### Test Failures (if any)
- [Description of failure]
- [Root cause if known]
- [Proposed fix]

## Git Status

### Modified Files (Uncommitted)
```
M path/to/file1.py
M path/to/file2.py
M path/to/file3.py
```

### Untracked Files
```
?? path/to/new-file.md
?? path/to/another-file.py
```

### Branches
- Current branch: `branch-name`
- Backup branches: `backup/branch-name` (if created)

### Commits Made This Session
- None (if uncommitted)
- OR list commits: `abc1234 - Commit message`
